title: Fresh confirmatory integrated multimodal PLM with collision-free modality encoding
question: Can the selected hidden_dim=64 residual-linear integrated PLM solve a fresh held-out cross-modal Boolean benchmark when modality encodings contain payload bits but no entity-ID side channel or payload/ID spatial collision?
hypothesis: The selected configuration will meet the registered 0.80 held-out q2 criterion on a fresh benchmark after removing the identified image payload/entity-ID collision without changing the model architecture or optimization budget.
held_constant: same hidden_dim=64 residual-linear model as E2E-007
same five seeds and 300-step training budget
fresh heldout compositions excluded from all prior development/confirmatory sets
no payload-bit or entity auxiliary supervision
fixed public operator dispatch and deterministic entity IDs remain scaffolds
identified E2E-007 image entity-ID/payload collision is removed in the benchmark generator only; model architecture is unchanged
leakage_rules: all prior sealed and development compositions are excluded from training
E2E-008 training and heldout compositions are disjoint
evaluation episodes are generated after training from a separate RNG namespace
training/evaluation semantic episode-key overlap must be zero
modality encoders contain payload bits only and no entity-ID side channel
query API contains no answer, outcome, reward, or payload labels
no auxiliary payload or entity supervision
classifier argmax must exactly agree with action >= 0.5
antecedent_defect: E2E-007 AND diagnosis identified image bits 4-5 as contaminated by an entity-ID stripe occupying rows 0-3 while bit patches for those bits occupy rows 1-3; E2E-008 removes that overlap and removes the entity-ID image stripe entirely.

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass, mean normal heldout q2 accuracy >= 0.80, and every seed >= 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: bounded confirmatory evidence that the selected residual-linear integrated PLM functions end to end on the corrected fresh synthetic benchmark
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal understanding, semantic memory, learned addressing, learned operator discovery, scaling or efficiency

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but the primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: the selected configuration does not meet the registered clean-benchmark capability criterion

arms.name: normal
arms.intervention: full clean text/image/audio observation, persistent state, residual-linear write

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state immediately before q1

arms.name: shuffle_image
arms.intervention: permute image observations across observed entities

arms.name: text_only
arms.intervention: replace image and audio with constants

arms.name: image_only
arms.intervention: replace text and audio with constants

arms.name: audio_only
arms.intervention: replace text and image with constants

interpretation_order: entity-side-channel absence and encoding collision audit
